episodes.title: Project trust bootstrap across extensions, skills, and themes
episodes.learn: Repair a project-trust bootstrap regression in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts and prove it with a focused test.
episodes.transfer: In a fresh session, repair a related trust-transition regression through a different resource path.
episodes.correction: A verified allowlist introduces an exception. Update the old blanket rule and implement the narrower boundary.
episodes.retransfer: Apply the corrected trust boundary to another project-local resource without rediscovering the bootstrap topology.

episodes.title: Legacy session migration and path safety
episodes.learn: Repair a migration defect involving legacy session headers and validate the accepted on-disk format.
episodes.transfer: In a fresh session, fix a different migration edge case while preserving the same path and compatibility invariants.
episodes.correction: Verified fixtures add an explicit collision policy. Replace any over-broad migration rule with that policy.
episodes.retransfer: Implement the corrected migration behavior for a different legacy fixture.

episodes.title: Tool replay policy and durable recovery
episodes.learn: Repair a recovery regression where only a persisted and still-safe tool may be replayed after interruption.
episodes.transfer: In a fresh session, apply the same durable-recovery distinction to a different tool batch failure.
episodes.correction: Verified metadata changes one operation from never-replay to safe-replay. Update the experience rather than retaining the old prohibition.
episodes.retransfer: Recover a new interrupted batch using the corrected, conditional replay rule.

protocol.warm_state: Only the system's normally persisted memory from learn and previous stages may cross boundaries.
protocol.cold_state: No durable state, transcript, diff, or hand-written summary may cross boundaries.
protocol.oracle_visibility: The oracle and mutation patch remain outside the agent-visible workspace.
